answer_1.quote: We evaluate our approach on two datasets, Amazon product reviews and Yelp reviews of businesses ... we present abstractive summaries generated by our model.

answer_2.quote: The reported ROUGE scores are based on F1 ... we use ROUGE metrics to evaluate the generated summaries.

answer_4.quote: We performed human evaluation using the AMT platform. Workers judged summaries with Best-Worst Scaling ...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to select the best and worst summary according to several criteria.
